challenges: 第１０の使徒: glossary '10th Angel' (official, akurasu mech list) breaks the style of its siblings 'the Fourth/Fifth/Sixth/Seventh/Ninth Angel' (Jigoku, en.wikipedia Angel_(Evangelion)). Case: robot 264 proposes 'the Tenth Angel'; wiki title is 'Tenth Angel' (https://evangelion.fandom.com/wiki/Tenth_Angel), and the library prose is inconsistent: pilot 393 'the battle against $$第１０の使徒$$' and 392 'absorbed by $$第１０の使徒$$' need an article from the token, while robot 258 already writes 'the $$第１０の使徒$$' (would become 'the the'). Recommendation: change the entry to 'the Tenth Angel' (like the others) and fix the robot 258 prose to drop its own 'the'. If the numeral form '10th Angel' stays, the prose needs 'the' added in pilot 392/393 and robot 264. Also the akurasu mech list writes all numbers as digits ('4th Angel', '7th Angel'), and the glossary already overrides it with 'the Seventh Angel' for all others.
retoken: pilot 397 DSCR (proposed by pt_396): $$ＥＶＡ仮設５号機|lc$$ -> $$ＥＶＡ仮設５号機$$ (the English is 'EVA Provisional Unit-05'; lc would produce 'eVA Provisional Unit-05')
No other retoken needed: 綾波レイ / アヤナミレイ（仮称） / アヤナミレイ are already different Japanese strings; レイ#pt394 is already tokenized.
uncertain: エヴァンゲリオン改２号機 / long 改２号機γ name: 'Kai' follows the akurasu mech list and the glossary's '(Kai)', but the official Rebuild English is 'Revised' (Fandom: 'Unit Two Revised Gamma'; akurasu pilot database: 'Evangelion Revised Unit-02γ'). The two akurasu files disagree; if the user prefers official English, use 'Evangelion Unit-02 Revised' style for both. Also 'Production Model' (glossary) vs the film's 'Utility Model'.
Long names for 改２号機γ and ８号機β are assembled from the glossary pattern, not attested as strings: marked proposed.

アヤナミレイ (CHNN): 'Rei (Tentative Name)' is my short-form proposal (proposed). Official form is only attested for the full 'Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name)' (Good Smile). Width of both should be checked in the pilot name fields; no bare 'Rei' because レイ#pt394 = Rei is a different being.

'(Tentative Name)' uses brackets although NAME_RESEARCH forbids brackets in en: the parentheses are part of the official name and the glossary already holds bracketed official names. Orchestrator may want an unbracketed form such as 'Tentative Rei'.

第３新東京市 = 'Tokyo-3' (official everywhere) vs original_1c 第２新東京市 = 'Neo Tokyo-2': same 新東京市 pattern, inconsistent English. Official Evangelion English calls the second one 'Tokyo-2' (Wikipedia characters list: 'Tokyo-2'). Original_1c should decide whether the game city is meant to echo Eva; note only.
'Near Third Impact' (fandom/evageeks page titles): the film's own subtitle spelling was not seen; some reviews write 'Near-Third Impact'. Marked official on the strength of both wiki titles.
Rank glosses for 二佐/一佐/二尉 are my own rendering (JSDF ranks); subtitles use Major/Colonel/Lieutenant loosely. Not used in a name token.

Fandom/EvaGeeks pages were not fetchable directly (HTTP 403/402); their content was taken from search-result snippets and Wikipedia raw text. Every 'official' cites at least one Wikipedia article or product page I could read.

Aliases to sync: レイ#pt394 = Rei (this group), レイ#pt231, レイ#pt136 are in macross.md / gundam_3.md; no spelling conflict with those groups. ユイ = Yui (this group) vs ヒイロ・ユイ = Heero Yui (gundam_5): distinct Japanese.
